噹噹在牆前坐下，告訴那個聲音，村裡的人還沒有回來。哭聲停了，轉而教他調息護身。他: Dangdang sits down in front of the wall and tells the voice that the villagers haven't come back yet. The crying stops, and the voice turns to teaching him how to regulate his breathing to guard his body. He practices along a few times, and his breathing gradually eases. Dangdang: "I've got it memorized. Thank you."
噹噹敲鬆牆腳的磚，取出布包，碎石卻割開了手背。他按住傷口，聽牆裡的聲音繼續勸阻。: Dangdang knocks loose the brick at the foot of the wall and takes out the cloth bundle, but the rubble slices open the back of his hand. He presses down on the wound and listens as the voice in the wall keeps trying to talk him out of it. Dangdang: "I know it's dangerous up there. The Master is still up there. I have to go."
池裡游著幾條肥魚，旁邊放了一籃小魚乾。噹噹剛蹲下，水底就掠過一道比他還寬的黑影。: A few fat fish swim in the pond, with a basket of Dried Fish set beside it. The moment Dangdang crouches, a dark shape wider than he is sweeps across the bottom of the water. Dangdang: "How big a one is still hiding beneath this pond?"
噹噹抓到一條魚，在池邊吃完，空著的肚子總算飽了。水裡的大影子仍在游，他收回前爪。: Dangdang catches a fish and finishes it at the pond's edge, his empty stomach finally full. The big shadow in the water is still swimming; he pulls back his front paw. Dangdang: "One is enough. Don't reach in again."
噹噹抱起籃子，一條粗尾巴突然掃出水面，把他打得側翻在地。他撐起身子，忍痛拖著籃子: Dangdang picks up the basket when a thick tail suddenly sweeps out of the water and knocks him sideways onto the ground. He pushes himself up and, bearing the pain, drags the basket away. Dangdang: "Cough... that was one heavy hit."
